instruction: Export all my Simple Note notes to "~/backups/notes/" directory in my file system. The files should be named according to the note title, replacing white space with "_", and the extension should be ".md".
notes: The number of Simple Note notes is unknown before runtime, so the problem uses a representative set of three notes (note-1..note-3); at runtime the agent must page through simple_note.search_notes until exhausted and repeat show_note + create_file for every note returned. Static facts note-content/note-file only link each note to its content object and its target path object (path = "~/backups/notes/" + title with whitespace replaced by "_" + ".md"); the actual content becomes known only after simple_note.show_note (known-content). search_notes sets the nullary notes-listed flag (all ids discovered in one call), which gates show_note. file_system.create_file creates the parent directory implicitly (no create_directory call in the reference). supervisor-complete-task carries the three note records as non-API parameters (with pairwise inequality) so its precondition equals the goal conjunction; it is called with status="success" and no answer. Logins require both the profile (username = supervisor email) and the passwords to be fetched first.
